name: vLLM#56770: MXFP4 W4A16 misclassified as W4A4 on SM100+
notes: compressed-tensors MXFP4 W4A16 is misclassified as W4A4 and dispatched to W4A4 kernel on SM100+ (B200). Root cause: FlashInferMxfp4LinearKernel selected instead of MarlinMxfp4Kernel. Accuracy: AIME-24 51.25% (wrong) vs 66.67% (correct). Demonstrates quantization accuracy loss from kernel misdispatch on Blackwell.
